title: Python Developer
description:
**Location:** Jaipur, Rajasthan, India.  

  

**Description:** As a **Python Developer** at **IWP \- Indian Wedding Planners**, you will develop, maintain and improve the internal software, websites, APIs, automation tools, data systems, dashboards and third\-party integrations that run AMK Hospitality IPL, Indian Wedding Planners and AMK Travels: leads, clients, bookings, weddings and events, guest management and RSVP, vendors, transport, hotels, payments and reports.  

  

**Department:**  

  

Technology / Digital Operations. Reports to Management / Director / assigned Project Lead. Full\-time, in\-office in Jaipur. Minimum 3 years of experience.  

  

**Key Responsibilities:**  

  

\* **Application Development and Feature Delivery:** Develop, maintain and enhance Python backend applications and modules for CRM, lead management, wedding and event planning, RSVP and guest lists, vendors, hotel bookings, transport, payment tracking, reports and dashboards; convert business requirements into practical solutions; estimate timelines and deliver on schedule.  

* **Backend Development, APIs and Integrations:** Build secure REST APIs and backend services with Django, Django REST Framework, Flask or FastAPI; integrate WhatsApp, email, SMS, payment gateways, Google services, CRM tools, booking platforms, maps and cloud storage; and handle authentication, validation, error handling, logging and API documentation.
* **Database Management and Data Accuracy:** Design and optimise MySQL, PostgreSQL or MongoDB databases; keep leads, clients, guests, bookings, vendors and payments accurate and consistent; set up secure backups and recovery; and handle confidential data responsibly.
* **Testing, Debugging and Quality Assurance:** Write clean, modular, documented code; run unit, functional and integration tests on staging before release; debug application, performance, server and data issues; maintain a bug tracker; and follow code\-review standards.
* **System Maintenance, Security and Performance:** Monitor performance, server health, logs and access; implement role\-based access, input validation and data protection; manage version control with Git; and support deployment and release management with hosting or cloud vendors.
* **Reporting, Documentation and Team Coordination:** Work with management, HR, sales, weddings, operations, travel and accounts to understand processes; document code, deployments, integrations and database structure; share daily or weekly updates; and train internal users on new features.


  

**Required Technical Skills:**  

  

\* Strong proficiency in Python, with Django, Django REST Framework, Flask or FastAPI.  

* Strong understanding of REST APIs, JSON, webhooks, authentication and third\-party integrations.
* Good working knowledge of MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB or similar databases, and Git/GitHub.
* Knowledge of HTML, CSS and JavaScript preferred; AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Docker, Linux or deployment experience is an advantage.
* Understanding of testing, debugging, logging, performance optimisation, security and data protection.
* Experience building CRM, ERP, booking, hospitality, travel, event, e\-commerce or workflow systems is preferred.


  

**Qualifications:**  

  

\* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, IT, Software Engineering or a related field preferred.  

* Minimum 3 years as a Python Developer, Backend Developer or Software Developer.
* Strong problem\-solving, the ability to work independently with non\-technical teams, and good written and verbal communication.
* Willing to work from the Jaipur office.


  

**Reporting and Deliverables:**  

  

\* Daily or weekly task\-status updates, and module\-wise development and deployment status.  

* Bug and issue\-resolution tracker, API and integration documentation, and database and backup status.
* Monthly summary of completed work, ongoing tasks, pending requirements, system issues and recommendations.


  

**Compensation:**  

  

Good salary, based on the candidate’s last drawn salary, technical skills, relevant experience and interview performance.

**Application Process:**  

Please email your resume to **hr@indianweddingplanners.in** with the subject \- For the Application of Python Developer
